folds.note: search fitness = TRAIN side of fold 0 (initial block); fold TEST sides are read only in the final survival stage (never in this probe)

search.note: DEAP/niche evolution gets min(fraction * n_candidates, pop * (gens + 1)) unique evaluations; the rest is random fill round-robin over all available archetypes

cost.note: TemporalEvaluator evaluates BASE and COMBINED_ADVERSE; lean search reads COMBINED_ADVERSE only. Costs per market: alpha.common.market_costs.cost_scenarios_for(spec)

sizing.note: DISCOVERY runs on a normalised 10,000 EUR research account (V1 DEFAULT_SIZING) so results are in comparable R and min-lot feasibility does not distort the search. Cost/sizing per market come from alpha.common.market_costs (cost_scenarios_for / sizing_for): spread-normalised slippage, risk band in median spreads, contract size / lot step / min lot from the MarketSpec, leverage min(10 research cap, spec cap)

account.note: ANNOTATION ONLY (never fitness/selection): min-lot / risk-fraction / leverage feasibility and the share of Train entries skipped size_below_min at the real account
